info.name: KINVENT Public API
info.description:
This collection includes detailed instructions and examples to help you navigate the authentication process and utilize the API effectively.

1. Make sure that you select "KINVENT - Public API Environment" environment configuration.
    
2. Every folder contains a description with notes about the entities and their usage.
    

> This particular collection is pointing to a staging test environment.  
It is highly recommended to familiarize first with the requests and structure before making requests to the production environment.

item.description:
### Authentication Flow:

1. **Login Request:** Begin by calling the Login request to authenticate yourself within the environment.
    
2. **Automatic Token Management:** Upon successful authentication, a Postman script will automatically execute to save the authentication token into an environment variable and also initializes the "updatedAfter" parameter.
    
3. **Token Usage:** This saved auth token will then be used in the headers of all subsequent API requests, ensuring seamless and authorized interactions with our API.

item.description:
### Important Note:

- **Delete Endpoint Behavior:** Please be aware that the delete endpoint does not permanently remove resources. Instead, it updates the resource's `deleted` field to `true`. This ensures that resources can be flagged as deleted while still retaining historical data.

item.description:
**Protocol** is a recorded activity performed by a participant using any of the K-Force devices.

Protocol is the top level hierarchy object in which **activities** are stored.

The configuration of each activity is stored inside config field and the measurements performed are stored inside the repetitions field in the activity resource.

### **Fetching protocols**

1. If you want to fetch protocols based on a particular participant, it is highly recommended to use "Find protocols by participantCode" endpoint since it is filtering protocols based on the participant's code.
    
2. The "updatedAfter" parameter is automatically calculated for the last week, in order to change the value please comment out the Postman script under the endpoints that make use of the parameter.
    

### **Analyzing protocols**

Analyze a Protocol and fetch the results of a recorded activity, performed by a participant using any of the K-Force sensors. This endpoint can accept many Protocol codes that will be analyzed in a batch.

The results of each activity is stored inside **activitiesResults**, a field of the **ProtocolAnalysisResult** resource. This field in a stringified JSON and it is different as per each activity type. Please check the different kind of analysis reports in the KINVENT Physio application.

For more details, please check the **ProtocolAnalysisServiceResponse and Protocol** objects in the **Schemas** section in our documentation site.

[https://www.api.documentation.k-invent.com/doc/index.html#/](https://www.api.documentation.k-invent.com/doc/index.html#/)
